embedded_audit.invocation: grok -m grok-4.5 --effort high --sandbox workspace --cwd <scratch>/grok-cwd --always-approve --disallowed-tools "search_replace,web_search,web_fetch,Agent" --max-turns 80 --output-format json --prompt-file AUDIT_INPUT.md; exact invocation record in review_bundle/AUDIT_INVOCATION.txt

findings.title: Pull/merge friction on dirty local copies of the former tracked caches
findings.body: Worktrees with a locally modified copy of either file must `git checkout -- <file>` before the deletion applies cleanly; disclosed in the PR body; does not affect runtime hooks.

findings.title: Historical #1273 blobs retain machine-local path/port snapshot
findings.body: The advisor-cache blob from 6aeb25001 stays reachable in history (local absolute paths, ports, instance id; no secrets). History rewrite is a separate decision; out of scope.

remaining_risks: F-01 (LOW, accepted): one-time checkout/pull conflict on worktrees where either cache is still dirty against the old tracked blob.
The advisor-cache writer lives outside the repo (~/.claude/hooks/dopemux_mcp_advisor.py); a future rename of its cache file would not be covered by the exact-path ignore rule.
F-02 (INFO, accepted): git history keeps the accidental #1273 cache blobs.
